title: Automate changelog and onboard Orion-Zeta 13B v1.1 (perf + metadata)
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Onboarded Orion-Zeta 13B v1.1 with curated performance profiles; added automated changelog generation for model registry updates.
body: Motivation: Provide production-ready metadata and perf profiles for Orion-Zeta 13B v1.1 and reduce manual work when publishing model changelogs. This PR performs three coordinated changes: (1) add model metadata and perf profiles for orion-zeta-13b v1.1, (2) add CI/workflow automation that generates a changelog entry when model metadata changes, and (3) wire the changelog generation into redwood-docs via an automated PR. Summary of changes: - new metadata YAML under models/orion-zeta/13b/v1.1/metadata.yaml containing canonical model name, tokenizer, recommended quantization profiles, default batch/sequence tuning, and tags. - perf profiles JSON under models/orion-zeta/13b/v1.1/perf_profiles.json with latency/throughput benchmarks across supported instance types and recommended kernel hints. - .github/workflows/model-changelog.yml: workflow that runs on push to model metadata paths and on schedule; generates a markdown changelog entry using the templating tool /tools/model-changelog, validates schema and formatting, and opens a docs PR to redwood-docs (title: chore(model-registry): add changelog for orion-zeta v1.1). - CI: new unit tests to validate metadata schema and perf profile values; integration step that runs a short benchmark harness (perf-canary) against a small subset of hosts to sanity-check numbers (mocked in CI). - docs: updated docs reference in docs/models.md to include the new model entry (automatically applied by generated PR). Checklist: - [x] Add metadata YAML and perf profiles - [x] Add changelog generation workflow and template - [x] Add unit tests and CI integration step - [x] Validate changelog PR creation to redwood-docs - [x] Smoke test serving of v1.1 in staging (canary) How it works: The workflow triggers on changes under models/**/metadata.yaml and perf_profiles.json and runs a short validation and templating step that produces a markdown blob. If validation passes, the workflow creates a branch and opens a PR against redwood-docs with the changelog. The templating tool extracts fields (model name, version, highlights, perf summary, migration notes) and formats them into a single changelog section; the PR body contains links to the model registry entry and perf artifacts. Testing and verification: - Local unit tests (schema) added under model-registry/tests/test_metadata.py - CI runs lint, unit tests, and a limited perf-canary job that posts results to a temporary bucket; these are validated by a GH action step that asserts metrics are within expected ranges before continuing. - Manual verification: staged model deployed to staging-redwood cluster and verified via /admin/model-catalog endpoint. Rollout plan: - Merge to main after approvals and CI pass - Workflow will open changelog PR to redwood-docs automatically; docs team will review as usual - Model will be enabled in staging and then scheduled for production canary (10% traffic) with monitoring for latency/cost regressions Notes and rationale: Automating changelog generation reduces friction for model onboarding and ensures changelogs stay consistent across versions. Perf profiles are conservative (measured with the same harness used for other onboards) and include recommended kernel and quantization settings to encourage consistent serving behavior. Related: ENG-4276 tracks follow-ups for perf-automation and ENG-4312 will add a dashboard for changelog PRs.
commits: add: perf profiles (perf_profiles.json) for orion-zeta v1.1
ci: add model-changelog workflow and templating tool invocation
test: add unit tests for metadata schema and perf profile validation
docs: small updates to models index to include orion-zeta (auto)
review_comments: Ethan Zhou: Can we include the tokenizer/version used for the reported perf numbers? Otherwise +1.
Maya Patel: Added tokenizer.version and test that pins tokenization used in CI.
Ravi Menon: CI perf-canary step flakes on macOS runners, switched to linux-only; please verify ephemeral bucket cleanup.
Ava Thompson: Approving once CI is green and docs PR is created by the workflow.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps perf numbers conservative; follow-up will expand instance coverage.
Changelog template is reusable for future onboards; tooling lives in /tools/model-changelog.
